message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV directly with pd.read_csv and applies fillna('') but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The pre-trained BERT model is loaded from HuggingFace Hub via BertTokenizer.from_pretrained and BertModel.from_pretrained with no pinned commit/revision, checksum verification, or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only replaces and merges labels for dataset-specific normalization purposes; there is no validation against an expected label set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool used to detect label flipping.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only label normalization and undersampling; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained BERT weights via `BertModel.from_pretrained(config.PRE_TRAINED_MODEL)` and `BertTokenizer.from_pretrained(config.PRE_TRAINED_MODEL)` using only a model name string with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision specified.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs label merging and undersampling but never explicitly validates that the resulting label distribution meets any expected criteria or checks for anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop in model.py contains no gradient anomaly detection, activation analysis, or any other backdoor/trigger defense mechanism.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is a standard torch.optim.Adam with no differential privacy wrapper such as Opacus or DP-SGD applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial stress-test logic are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no isolation guarantee (e.g., signed/hashed evaluation data, separate hold-out set locked away), and undersampling operations run on the full dataset before the split, risking leakage; no multiple independent metrics or tamper-protection mechanism is i
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV data and tokenizes it without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds are applied to the model's output logits or predictions anywhere in the visible code.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a BERT-based multi-label classifier (not an LLM text-in/text-out system), and there are no prompt-injection filters, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation mechanisms present.
